title: Identification of severity-sensitive items for the detection of cognitive impairments relevant to everyday life and validation of a new procedure for the initial assessment of cognition in geriatrics - AssCo 1
summary:
The newly developed AssCo 1 procedure aims to make the initial assessment of the mental capacity of patients in geriatrics more appropriate. It aims to achieve the greatest possible therapeutically useful knowledge in a way that is as gentle as possible for patients and staff.

The planned study is therefore guided by the question:
Can a procedure be developed that allows reliable statements about the mental capacity of the examined patient right at the beginning of a hospital stay without beeing overly confronting or demanding?

interventions.name:
Patients in geriatrics and geriatric traumatology will be examined at two points in time:

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Inpatients and day patients of a geriatric clinic and a center for geriatric traumatology
- Good understanding of the German language
- Adequate hearing
- Adequate language skills
- Adequate visual acuity (MMSE and clock test)
- Adequate motor skills (MMSE and clock test)
- Ability to provide information and consent, or consent of the legal representative
Exclusion criteria:
- Inadequate ability to cooperate or be examined due to delirium
- Inadequate ability to be examined due to very poor general condition, severe pain, or other symptoms (severe exhaustion, extreme fatigue, etc.)
- Known intellectual disability
- Acute danger to self or others
